programme.desc: Isabelle tackles a great classic that brings joy on any occasion: chocolate cake.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: "Entre Haute-Loire et Ardèche, les grands espaces du Mézenc se découvrent avec Valérie Courbon, productrice de fruits rouges, et Florian Gibaud, éleveur. Sortie marmottes avec Alexandre Aubry, accompagnateur en montagne ; sensibilisation des randonneurs à la préservation du mont Mézenc avec Sébastien Michel, médiateur et guide nature."

programme.title: Comment ça pousse ?
programme.desc: Banane, patate, cacahuète, cannelle, safran... Tout le monde connaît et en a sans doute déjà mangé. Mais savez-vous comment ça pousse ?

programme.title: Papilles
programme.desc: A journey rich in flavour through the regions and their terroirs, exploring local specialities and meeting the artisans perpetuating their age-old culinary traditions. An opportunity to stop off in the kitchen of a talented chef to prepare an emblematic regional recipe.

programme.title: Les quatre coins de l’assiette S02
programme.desc: Au Nouveau-Brunswick, le chef Michel Savoie concocte une langue de boeuf, issue de la ferme Boudreau, des légumes de saison de la ferme La Belle Besogne et des micro-verdures de culture hydroponique de Local by Atta.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S08
programme.desc: Annick Jeanmairet et Simon Romang vous proposent du cabillaud aux lentilles vertes, lard valaisan et vinaigrette de moules. Découverte du jour : la pêche au silure, un poisson mal aimé et pourtant très bon.

programme.title: LA CUISINE D’ISABELLE ET RICARDO
programme.desc: Isabelle concocte l'accompagnement idéal pour un dîner d'automne : des petits pains au lait et un beurre à l'ail noir. On en apprend aussi davantage sur ce dernier ingrédient.

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03
programme.desc: "La famille Claveau-Audet participe à l'événement Mai sans tondeuse et plante du trèfle. Véronique réalise son rêve en agrandissant le potager. C'est sous la pluie que les élèves de l'Académie débutent leur journée de plantation avec Dany."

programme.title: Safran & saveurs by chef Simo
programme.desc: Chef Simo propose une rencontre culinaire entre la Côte d'Ivoire et le Maroc, avec un plat mêlant attiéké, poisson mariné au citron confit, huile d'argan et raisins secs. Une ode à la diversité africaine !

programme.title: Ton plat mon plat
programme.desc: Web-série qui valorise les aliments et les condiments de la gastronomie africaine dans une ambiance cosy, détendue et interactive.

programme.title: Papilles
programme.desc: Cheffe incontournable de la gastronomie au Maroc, Myriam Ettahri nous reçoit chez elle pour nous fait découvrir Taghazout Bay et la région d'Agadir, un terroir haut en couleurs et en saveurs. L'occasion de rencontrer la fine fleur de la gastronomie marocaine et française.

programme.title: Les quatre coins de l’assiette S02
programme.desc: "La chef Fisun Ercan, au Québec, offre un plat inspiré par la cuisine turque, avec des gourganes de Légunord, le verjus d'Au fil du vent et les artichauts de la ferme La Fille du Roy."

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S08
programme.desc: "Au menu : gnocchis de potimarron, sauce crème parmesan ail. Et quelques poires pochées au caramel. Découverte du jour : une formule antigaspi pour valoriser le résidu issu de l'huile de noix : le nillon."

programme.title: LA CUISINE D’ISABELLE ET RICARDO
programme.desc: La saison du chou-fleur est presque terminée ! Isabelle le propose façon « steak » épicé, sauce ranch au tahini ainsi que dans une trempette aux haricots blancs avec de l'ail rôti.

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03
programme.desc: "Ça pousse chez les Claveau-Audet ! La famille poursuit ses plantations et découvre les strophaires. La température permet finalement aux élèves de planter de bons légumes qui serviront à la confection de leur sauce spaghetti."

programme.title: Safran & saveurs by chef Simo
programme.desc: Chef Simo nous fait voyager entre l'Asie et l'Orient avec des rouleaux de feuille de riz garnis de pommes, cannelle et raisins secs. Une explosion sucré-salé, légère et raffinée !

programme.title: Ton plat mon plat
programme.desc: Web-série qui valorise les aliments et les condiments de la gastronomie africaine dans une ambiance cosy, détendue et interactive.

programme.title: Papilles
programme.desc: Il est le talentueux chef de l'hôtel Strato, à Courchevel : Thomas Prodhomme nous accueille dans son paradis blanc. Des sentiers enneigés aux étables d'alpage, découverte de son univers gourmand.

programme.title: Les quatre coins de l’assiette S02
programme.desc: "À Ottawa, le chef Marc Lepine propose un plat de viande de wapiti d'Elk Ranch, avec de la fleur d'ail de la ferme Ail Mayo Hill Garlic et le navet hakurei de Backyard Edibles."

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S08
programme.desc: Au menu : blanquette de veau à la fève tonka. Découverte du jour : beef jerky 100 % local, artisanal, sans additifs.

programme.title: LA CUISINE D’ISABELLE ET RICARDO
programme.desc: Quand les légumes se font généreux et colorés ! Isabelle cuisine un macaroni au fromage à la courge ainsi qu'une salade de roquette à la truite et aux betteraves jaunes.

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03
programme.desc: "C'est les pieds dans la boue que les élèves de l'Académie poursuivent leurs travaux. Les Claveau-Audet plantent des fraises en balconnière et, avec Édith, offrent des plantations à un organisme de Terrebonne."

programme.title: Safran & saveurs by chef Simo
programme.desc: Chef Simo mixe traditions marocaines, italiennes et indiennes, avec une recette originale : langues d'oiseau, épices exotiques et parmesan dans un risotto vegan délicieux !

programme.title: Ton plat mon plat
programme.desc: Web-série qui valorise les aliments et les condiments de la gastronomie africaine dans une ambiance cosy, détendue et interactive.

programme.title: Papilles
programme.desc: Dans la baie du Mont-Saint-Michel, Philippe Hardy, chef étoilé, nous emmène à la découverte du terroir normand. Des cuisines de son restaurant Le Mascaret à la visite des marchés de coquilles Saint-Jacques, une occasion de retrouver les plaisirs de la gastronomie locale.

programme.title: Les quatre coins de l’assiette S02
programme.desc: "Le chef Gene Cormier, à Moncton au Nouveau-Brunswick, cuisine des saucisses allemandes de l'entreprise Dagenhardt, du kimchi de Lee&Shin Korean Food et des cosses de la ferme Terre partagée."

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S08
programme.desc: Simon et Annick nous proposent la recette de la polenta au ragù de saucisse. Découverte du jour : des merveilles artisanales fabriquées en Valais.

programme.title: LA CUISINE D’ISABELLE ET RICARDO
programme.desc: C'est la fête en cuisine : Isabelle s'attaque à un savoureux gâteau d'anniversaire à la vanille et Ricardo propose des astuces pour le réussir à tous les coups.

programme.title: C’est plus qu’un jardin S03
programme.desc: "Édith et les élèves de l'Académie des Sacrés-Coeurs introduisent une ruche, des plantes pollinisatrices et un hôtel d'insectes à leur potager. Véronique et Bryan plantent des légumes antillais. La mi-saison est le temps idéal pour les successions."

programme.title: The Legend of Glynn Turman
programme.desc: The life story and career of legendary actor Glynn Turman. At 12 years old he made his Broadway debut in the classic and original production of “A Raisin in the Sun” opposite all-time great, Sidney Poitier. For the last 6 decades he has graced the silver screen, television, and stage with performances of brilliance and excellence. The film chronicles his childhood, born in New York to his journey to Hollywood, becoming one of the world’s best actors.

programme.title: False Profits
programme.desc: Delilah is imprisoned for fraud after being apart of her family’s gospel group which was a front for a ponzi scheme. She agrees to be interviewed by a local reporter about her past and her side of the crime. On the day of the interview, her sister performs a song hinting at hidden truths about her past.

programme.title: Carmen and Magic
programme.desc: When Carmen meets a new friend at school named Magic, she helps raise her spirits and allows her to stand up for herself. programme.title: Apex

programme.title: The Perfect Mother

Linda rises to the challenge of overcoming adversary to reunite her family and save her son.

programme.title: Her Other Man
programme.desc: Looking to spice up their marriage, Kennedy invites another man, Billy, into the bedroom with her husband Ronny. When Billy is found dead, Ronny is being questioned about his murder.

programme.title: The Jealous Son
programme.desc: Seduced by her boyfriend's charming son, a woman soon finds herself trapped in a dangerous obsession that will push her to her limits.

When the remains of an apartheid-era policeman are discovered 60 years after he went missing, a retired singer revisits her past to help with the investigation. But how much does she know, and what is she holding back?

programme.title: Fatal Promises
programme.desc: Haunted by unresolved trauma, Renae Morgan swears off love until Kingston Coleman, a charming and powerful attorney, pulls her back in. programme.title: ToxiCity

Their romance sours as Sierra's past as a dancer and her aggressive jealousy come to light.

programme.title: The Loyalty Test
programme.desc: Trey Harrison is an up-and-coming internet star that has created a series exposing cheaters in orchestrated sting operations, successfully turning heartbreak into a viral spectacle. But when two participants are found murdered, Trey’s world begins to crumble and things only begin to escalate.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Advent Calendar Part 3
programme.desc: The base for the advent calendar is made with 1/2″ ply, butt joints and brad nails. Doesn’t get simpler than that! Once the construction is complete, I embark on a journey into the world of faux finishing with a 2-part distressed paint job.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Birth Of A Guitar Part 1
programme.desc: "This is a Wood Whisperer first: a series featuring an aspiring luthier, Rick Urschel. Rick takes us through the process of building a classic guitar from a kit available at LMII.com. This is Rick’s first attempt at a guitar, and as such, I am not presenting this as a “how-to”. Instead, this is just one man’s experience as he works his butt off making a beautiful guitar for his wife. I think you are really going to enjoy it. A special thanks to Rick for allowing me to “Whisperize” his content!"

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: SketchUp Basics - Trunk Lid Part 2
programme.desc: In part two of our three-part series, Aaron shows us how to make the frame parts for the top of our lid. Now these videos do assume that you’ve opened the program and have a little familiarity with the tools.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Mini Trebuchet
programme.desc: Build a miniature trebuchet and sling some crap around!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Scary Mystery Dust and Kitchen Remodel
programme.desc: We find some mystery dust in the walls which causes us to pivot to the kitchen remodel.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Lessons Learned from Past Projects
programme.desc: Ever wish you could fast forward 5 years and see how your projects are holding up? That would certainly be useful information as it would let you know what worked, and what didn’t. So in this episode, I pull out a number of old projects and examine them closely for damage, flaws and evidence of wood movement.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Mortising Jigs & Through Mortises
programme.desc: There are lots of methods available for making mortises. One of the most versatile tools for mortising is the hand-held router. You can do a lot with the manufacturer's edge guide but you can do even more if you know how to design and construct simple jigs or guides.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Interview with Kaleo Kala
programme.desc: A chat with woodworker and designer, Kaleo Kala.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Wall-Hanging Magazine Rack
programme.desc: This video shows you how to build the Wall-Hanging Magazine Rack, designed by Glen Huey. And because I don't like to leave well enough alone, I'll also show you an alternative version of the magazine rack that employs a few of my personal design changes.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: A Classic Picture Frame
programme.desc: A classic picture frame for a special piece of art.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Bit Storage Cabinet
programme.desc: A wall-hanging cabinet to help you organize and store your drill and router bits.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Tricking Out a Cheap Desk
programme.desc: Instead of replacing a cheap desk, let's see if we can trick it out and make it more functional.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Veneered Pantry Cabinet
programme.desc: A veneered pantry cabinet featuring continuous grain.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Exploded Sofa Table
programme.desc: My mom recently requested I build her a sofa table since everything she found was either too big or too small. Her size requires were 30″ High, 14″ Deep, and 46″ Wide. As long as I hit those dimensions she didn't care what the table looked like. I took this as a fun opportunity to design on the fly, experimenting with some 'new to me' ideas and tapping into my creative side.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Moving Out of the Dream Shop
programme.desc: It seems that I'm gaining something of a reputation as a "frequent shop-mover." It's probably well-deserved since I've moved my shop four times already. If you're playing along with the Where's The Wood Whisperer home game, here's the score so far.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Kids Kitchen Step Stool
programme.desc: The Kids Kitchen Step Stool is an asset to any family with kids! One of Nicole's favorite things to do with our son is cook. So I set out to design a kids step-stool that includes features like safety elements, height adjustability, custom-sizing for kitchen countertops, and a nice wide platform. The end result is the Kids Kitchen Step Stool with some Arts & Crafts flair.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Installing LED Shop Lighting
programme.desc: We're working exclusively with American Green Lights who designed and supplied our lighting solution. The fixtures are PerformaLUX SL Series in both single strip 24 W models and 5-strip 60 W models. These units can save 50-60% compared to traditional fluorescent lights, have a lifetime of 120,000 hours, and feature a CRI of 92-95 (for color accuracy).

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shellac Under Polyurethane
programme.desc: I decided to do a little experiment for myself. I wanted to see if I could find any evidence of a weakened bond between polyurethane and waxed shellac, when the shellac is used in a typical manner as a sealer.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Low Entertainment Center Part 4
programme.desc: An important aspect of building furniture that many new woodworkers overlook is the importance of finishing before the project is completely glued together. That’s the primary focus of this part of the series.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Hand Tool Basics with Kaleo Kala
programme.desc: A quick review of some basic hand tool techniques with my buddy Kaleo Kala.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Artist's Easel
programme.desc: This year's Woodworkers Fighting Cancer build is an awesome little artist's easel. This is a simple project that can be easily done in a weekend!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Castle Bookcase
programme.desc: The Castle Bookcase is not only great for storage but also serves as a creative play center for kids of all ages. It features four shelves, a functional drawbridge, battlements, and windows. The entire thing is made from two sheets of plywood and is constructed using glue and screws. For additional strength you can cut dados for the shelves as demonstrated in the video.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 5 Tips for Laying Out Project Parts
programme.desc: Whenever I lay out my project parts in rough lumber, I find that there are 5 things that I always try to keep in mind.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Why Are We Destroying a Perfectly Good Table?!
programme.desc: Why would be destroy a perfectly good table? To make it even better, of course!!!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Sculpted End Table Part 3
programme.desc: I start by gluing the leg blanks to the aprons. I then cut the rough shape out on the bandsaw. And finally, I use the template and a flush trim bit in the router table to get the exact shape we’re after. I also spend a good deal of time discussing the dangers involved with this routing operation.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Bosch Glide Vs Festool Kapex
programme.desc: I don't consider myself a very good reviewer. I have no desire to do a feature by feature and spec for spec rundown commonly found in our favorite woodworking magazines. Instead, all I can offer is one man's opinion and a completely biased personal impression based on my needs and the type of work I do. So here it is!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Guitar Pick Cutting Board
programme.desc: A triangular cutting board that will never wobble.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfette leads the Smurflings on a nature hike, but Puppy gets too far ahead and they chase him into the land of the Wartmongers. King Bullrush captures them in bubbles and imprisons them. A group of rebels rescue the Smurflings and they escape on the back of Puppy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What, or who, is that strange being in the forest? It looks vaguely like a Smurf, but it chatters away like the squirrel that seems to be accompanying it… And why is Papa Smurf talking about the Lost Smurfling?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Snappy has a new trick: he frightens everybody, or tries to, with his hand-puppet dragon. But it gets, shall we say, out of hand when Papa Smurf's magic liquid falls on the puppet and it comes alive. Alive and kicking, what's more, endangering Snappy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends

programme.title: Monster Town
programme.desc: Meet the Monster Trucks, a gang of colossal, hard-working cars who team up to help their friends and community in Monster City.

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: The Fixies
programme.desc: The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment. There’s just no end to the troubles Tom Thomas and his Fixie friends get themselves into with all the gadgets and appliances around them!

programme.title: Gummy Bear and Friends
programme.desc: Gummy lives in an apartment with his friend Harry the Chameleon, while his other friend Kala the Cat hangs out in a ninja dojo on the roof. Together they go on wild and wacky adventures in their building and hometown. Enjoy the fun and crazy adventures!

programme.title: Grojband
programme.desc: The story about 12 year old Corey that emotionally torments his sister so that she will write the ultimate lyrics for his garage band.

programme.title: Box Yourself
programme.desc: Great Projects From Ordinary Cardboard!

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: RoboFuse

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: En su camino, Chip y sus amigos encuentran una isla rodeada por un gran lago de ácido, bajo la constante amenaza de erupción de un volcán. En la isla viven átomos de lantánidos que, según la leyenda, esperan la llegada de un «elegido» que les proporcione el ácido que les impide abandonar la isla. Chip, gracias a su libro, descubre que el volcán emitió una base que, al mezclarse con el ácido, puede neutralizar el peligroso lago y convertirlo en una agradable extensión de agua salada.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: En medio de un desierto abrasador, Chip y los átomos se encontraron con un átomo de tungsteno que les brindó refugio bajo un edificio piramidal que, hasta hacía poco, contaba con un ingenioso sistema de refrigeración por el que circulaba una corriente de amoníaco en su sótano. Pero ahora, el Dr. No ha desviado el flujo de amoníaco para su propio beneficio. Chip descubre el punto donde se desvía el amoníaco y construye una presa que lo devuelve a su curso normal.

programme.desc: SoCal summer is calling, and the Local Knowledge crew is back on Ali’s home turf in San Diego, California. programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.desc: Part heart-pounding adventure, part spiritual quest, THE HIGHEST PASS, a feature length documentary, premiered in Los Angeles to sold out audiences. Over 21 days and up to an elevation of 18,000 feet along a winding road, they never let low oxygen, altitude sickness, river-flooded roads, icy edges, snow and loaded trucks dampen their spirits or, ultimately, their deeper selves.

programme.title: Millionaire Maker
programme.desc: Shawn Meaike's Millionaire Maker is a new series that shows you what you're really worth. Shawn is confident he could pluck anyone - no matter their background or experience - and turn them into a 7-figure earner...IF, they have the right attitude and drive. This series is about Shawn selecting who he will mentor and teach to reach a level of success they never thought possible. Welcome to the toughest job interview of your life. In this episode, Shawn meets the contestants and immediately finds out who's actually willing to fight for the life they want.

programme.title: Millionaire Maker
programme.desc: Shawn only wants folks who are willing to be honest about their struggles because it shows you can be fearless. Everyone deserves a happy life...but he can only help you if you're ready to take a chance on yourself. In this episode, the candidates have to sell themselves. They have to tell Shawn their story because he wants to know how you got stuck...but more importantly, they have to convince him they won’t give up...no matter how hard it is to hang on, or take a leap of faith.

programme.title: Millionaire Maker
programme.desc: If you had a chance to close Shawn, could you get it done? Today's the day we see who has the goods. Each team has one goal. Get the contract signed. Shawn is not going to make it easy, but often your audience isn't the hardest part. Sometimes getting out of your own way is the biggest challenge. Prepare to witness a pitch fest for the ages. You'll see that it doesn't matter what you're selling - a Yacht, a Ferrari, a Private Jet...or a Potato - if you don't connect with Shawn, you have no chance.

programme.title: Millionaire Maker
programme.desc: This is it. A winner will be chosen. The decision is FINAL...But we still have a crowd of candidates that each think they will be the one. Now comes a test of mental toughness. It's all come down to these final moments. Who can convince Shawn that they won't give up when things get...painful. What would you endure for a chance at greatness?...Watch the season finale of Shawn Meaike's Millionaire Maker.

programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.desc: The New York Atlas attackman had a historic sophomore season including the Jim Brown MVP Award and a Championship.

programme.title: Marcus Holman and the Moment He Became Obsessed with Lacrosse
programme.desc: Kyle Harrison sits down with Marcus Holman - one of lacrosse’s greatest shooters and leaders - for an honest conversation about family, obsession, adversity, longevity, and chasing the all-time goals record. Marcus takes us back to his earliest memories from John's Hopkins’ locker room to the moment he fell in love with shooting He opens up about evolving his role, becoming a leader, sustaining greatness into his mid-30s, and what it would mean to cement his legacy in the record books.

programme.title: Trevor Baptiste: Pressure, Expectations, and What Comes Next
programme.desc: Kyle Harrison sits down with Trevor Baptiste - the most dominant faceoff athlete of his generation - for an honest conversation about mentality, evolution, pressure, and the moments that shaped his journey to becoming an all-time great. From a chance clinic in eighth grade to a national championship as a freshman, Baptiste opens up about staying even-keeled, proving himself year after year, and why he still believes his best lacrosse is ahead of him.

programme.title: Brennan O’Neill Opens Up About Becoming ‘The Guy’

programme.title: God's Gun
programme.desc: A gunman (Jack Palance) makes a fatal mistake when he and his gang ravage a town and murder the local priest (Lee Van Cleef). Now, the priest’s twin brother vows revenge, and teams with a local boy (Leif Garrett) to bring the gunman and his gang to their knees. Lee Van Cleef played dual roles in this 1977 Spaghetti Western produced by Golan-Globus Productions.

Directed by Giulio Petroni, this 1967 Spaghetti Western features a musical score by the legendary Ennio Morricone.

Murnau’s unauthorized adaptation of Bram Stoker’s 1897 novel Dracula, vampire Count Orlock (Max Schreck) leaves Transylvania in search of a young woman, Ellen Hutter (Greta Schroder), while evading her husband, Thomas (Gustav von Wangenheim), and the Van Helsing-esque Professor Bulwer (Gustav Botz). A monumental achievement in German Expressionism, Nosferatu is revered as one of the most influential horror films of all time.
